title: Development of Indole-3-yl-methylene-thiobarbital Derivatives as Inhibitors of HDAC8 Enzyme Activity.
authors: Elsayed, Abdelrahman A F; Zhang, Jianqiu; Shalas, Alvan F; van der Wouden, Petra E; van Pinxteren, Donald J M; Jespers, Willem; Dekker, Frank J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HDAC8酶抑制剂设计与合成，虽含分子动力学模拟，但对象为酶-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Histone deacetylase 8 (HDAC8), a zinc-dependent class I enzyme, plays key roles in regulating gene expression and is implicated in various malignancies. Although hydroxamic acid-based inhibitors, like PCI-34051, have demonstrated potent HDAC8 inhibition, limitations including poor selectivity, instability, and off-target effects underscore the need for novel scaffolds. Here, we designed and synthesized a series of indole-based (thio)barbiturate derivatives to identify selective HDAC8 inhibitors. Compound 3d showed promising potency (IC(50) = 2.9 muM) and selectivity for HDAC8 over other isoforms. Structure-activity relationship studies revealed that thiobarbituric acid and 2-methylindole scaffolds enhanced HDAC8 inhibition. Remarkably, compound 3r emerged as the most potent inhibitor (IC(50) = 0.08 muM), exhibiting slow-binding kinetics, nanomolar potency, and high selectivity over HDAC1, 2, 3, and 6. Furthermore, compound 3r selectively induced SMC3 hyperacetylation in THP-1 cells, confirming its functional HDAC8 inhibition. Computational modeling and molecular dynamics simulations rationalized the experimental SAR and suggested an allosteric mechanism of inhibition.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白去乙酰化酶8（HDAC8）是一种锌依赖的I类酶，在调控基因表达中发挥关键作用，并与多种恶性肿瘤相关。尽管基于异羟肟酸的抑制剂，如PCI-34051，已显示出强效的HDAC8抑制作用，但其选择性差、不稳定及脱靶效应等局限性凸显了对新型骨架的需求。在此，我们设计并合成了一系列基于吲哚的（硫代）巴比妥酸衍生物，以鉴定选择性HDAC8抑制剂。化合物3d显示出有前景的效力（IC(50) = 2.9 μM）及对HDAC8相对于其他亚型的选择性。构效关系研究表明，硫代巴比妥酸和2-甲基吲哚骨架增强了HDAC8抑制作用。值得注意的是，化合物3r成为最强效抑制剂（IC(50) = 0.08 μM），表现出慢结合动力学、纳摩尔级效力及对HDAC1、2、3和6的高选择性。此外，化合物3r在THP-1细胞中选择性诱导SMC3高乙酰化，证实了其功能性HDAC8抑制作用。计算建模和分子动力学模拟合理化了实验性SAR，并提示了一种变构抑制机制。
